question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sensation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sensation **means the perception or experience of sensory information, like touch, taste, sight, sound, or smell. (स्पर्श, स्वाद, दृष्टि, ध्वनि या गंध जैसी संवेदी जानकारी की धारणा या अनुभव)

 
 
• **For example**: *The ice-cold water gave me a shiver of sensation as I jumped into the lake.*
 
 
 
• In the context of this passage, the word that best fits in the 5th blank must depict the positive emotions and sensations one experiences when flying, as per the description provided.
 
• This particular sentence is discussing the physical feeling of flying and contrasts the effort needed with the pleasure experienced from it.
 
• Given these requirements, the word '**sensation**' can be the most suitable option because it typically refers to a physical feeling or the way something physical feels.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indignation**: Strong anger or resentment due to feeling unfairly treated or offended. (अनुचित व्यवहार या अपमानित महसूस करने के कारण तीव्र क्रोध या नाराजगी)
 
• **Lamination**: The process of layering or covering with thin sheets, often to protect or strengthen an object. (किसी वस्तु को सुरक्षित या मजबूत करने के लिए अक्सर पतली चादरें बिछाने या ढकने की प्रक्रिया)
 
• **Perversion**: Distortion or corruption from its original state, often involving a deviation from accepted norms, morals, or behaviours. (अपनी मूल स्थिति से विकृति या भ्रष्टाचार, जिसमें अक्सर स्वीकृत मानदंडों, नैतिकता या व्यवहार से विचलन शामिल होता है)
